obfuscation_indicators: Adjusted PTC better reflects underlying business performance
strategic decisions to dispose of or acquire
risk_summary: The disclosure presents a generally positive performance narrative with substantial quantified changes in earnings, margins, debt, and interest expense. Risk visibility is reduced by extensive non-GAAP emphasis, numerous offsetting adjustments, foreign-exchange effects, impairments, and omitted detail following several “driven by” statements. The business remains exposed to leverage, currency volatility, asset sales, tax changes, and project-specific impairments.
